The narrative context clearly identifies 王郎 as 王凝之. The candidate evidence from people.json confirms 王凝之 as a person. No contradicting evidence.

The candidate evidence from people.json confirms 王凝之 as a person. The hard veto against c0 (王凝之 as a different candidate) is appropriate since c0 and c1 both resolve to the same person 王凝之 — this is a duplicate candidate issue, not an identity contradiction. The identification of 凝之 as 王凝之 is sound.
